---
title: "Speech Intelligibility in Parkinson’s Disease"
subtitle: "A Study for Speech-Language Pathologists"
---

## About the Study

We are studying how speech-language pathologists estimate speech intelligibility in Parkinson’s disease and how these methods can be improved. This research aims to support more reliable and standardized clinical assessment.

## What participation involves

Participation takes place entirely online and can be completed from your own device.

You will:

-   Listen to short speech samples from individuals with Parkinson’s disease
-   Make judgments about how understandable the speech is using different approaches

The study takes approximately 20–30 minutes to complete.

## Who can participate

You may be eligible if you:

-   Hold a CCC-SLP (ASHA-certified)
-   Have experience working with individuals with dysarthria
-   Are a native English speaker and currently located in the United States
-   Have no hearing difficulties that would interfere with listening

## Compensation

Participants will receive a \$20 electronic gift card upon completion of the study.
